name: approval_check
description: Check an approval request's status, polling ntfy for a button answer. wait_seconds blocks until answered/expired or the wait elapses (poll every 3s). Act only on status 'approved'; treat 'denied' and 'expired' as no. There is deliberately no MCP tool to ANSWER an approval — answering your own request defeats the protocol.

wait_seconds.description: Keep polling this long (default: one poll, no wait).

pushSuppressed.description: request only: quiet-hours window that held the push. The request still exists and is answerable.

name: approval_list
description: List approval requests, newest first. Filter by status to see what's pending.

pushSuppressed.description: request only: quiet-hours window that held the push. The request still exists and is answerable.

name: approval_request
description: Ask the human for approval via an ntfy push with [Approve] [Deny] buttons; returns a token to poll with approval_check. Use before doing anything consequential you were not explicitly asked to do (sending, buying, deleting). Requires ntfy in ~/.config/apple-tasks/notify.json.

question.description: What is being asked, e.g. 'Send the reply draft to Sarah?'

task.description: Task id this approval belongs to (audit trail).

expires_minutes.description: Pending requests expire after this long (default 240).

force.description: Priority: push even during quiet hours.

pushSuppressed.description: request only: quiet-hours window that held the push. The request still exists and is answerable.

name: audio_scan
description: Transcribe audio notes dropped in the iCloud inbox folder since the last scan (watermark auto-advances; first run looks back 24h). On-device Speech recognition; emits {file, modified, transcript, error?}. Failed files are retried next scan. Set archive:true to move transcribed files into a done/ subfolder.

since.description: Override watermark (yyyy-MM-dd, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm', or ISO8601). Stateless: does not advance the stored watermark.

archive.description: Move transcribed files into a done/ subfolder.

name: audit_log
description: Read the apple-tasks audit log: every mutation (task/event create/update/complete/delete, dispatches) with timestamp and caller (mcp/app/dispatcher/terminal). Use to check 'did I already do this?' before acting.

task.description: Only entries for this task id.

name: calendar_list
description: List Calendar calendars with writability.

name: clipboard_scan
description: Emit the clipboard's text if it changed since the last scan (changeCount watermark). At most one clipping per call — the pasteboard has no history. Password-manager/transient clippings are never surfaced, and the first call only records a baseline. Feed hits to triage like any capture channel.

name: contact_search
description: Search Apple Contacts by name, or by email address when the query contains '@'. Read-only, always. Returns id, name, emails, phones, birthday, postal addresses. Use to resolve WHICH person a task/event refers to (put their email in the event notes) or to rank known senders in mail triage.

query.description: Name fragment (e.g. 'sarah') or an email address.

birthday.description: yyyy-MM-dd, or MM-dd when the year is unknown.

name: contact_show
description: Show one Apple Contact by identifier (from contact_search). Read-only.

birthday.description: yyyy-MM-dd, or MM-dd when the year is unknown.

name: digest
description: Morning digest: agent activity since yesterday (audit log), dispatch outcomes, tasks due today, and today's calendar, as one JSON blob. Optionally writes it as a new Apple Note (note: true) and/or pushes a one-line summary to the configured ntfy topic (push: true).

since.description: Look-back start (yyyy-MM-dd, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm', or ISO8601; default 24h ago).

note.description: Write the digest as a new Apple Note.

note_folder.description: Notes folder for the digest note.

push.description: Send a short summary to the configured ntfy topic.

externalId.description: Sync-stable identifier; also accepted wherever a task id is.

nativeTags.description: add/update only: whether tags were mirrored to native Reminders tags.

subtask.description: update only: whether a --parent subtask change was applied.

recurred.description: complete only: completing this recurring task rolled it to the next occurrence (shown still open).

fileURL.description: Path in the Reminders store; reading the file needs Full Disk Access.

attached.description: task_update attach_* only: whether the attach succeeded.

section.description: task_show with section: true only — the task's section name.

sectionApplied.description: task_update section only: whether the assign succeeded.

start.description: yyyy-MM-dd for all-day events, ISO8601 otherwise.

noteCreated.description: Created note id when note: true.

pushed.description: Whether the ntfy push succeeded when push: true.

reason.description: Why this is worth raising, citing the signal.

suggestions.description: suggest: true only — proposals, never applied.

suggestError.description: suggest: true only — why proposals were unavailable.

name: dispatch_list
description: Show the dispatch ledger: agent runs with status, exit code, outcome summary, run log path, worktree.

name: dispatch_run
description: Run the agent dispatcher: scan open [auto] tasks, launch configured agents, reap stale runs, GC worktrees. A leading agent tag pins that lane; [auto] alone walks modelPrefs.auto (any available worker). dry_run defaults to TRUE (reports what would run, launches nothing); a real run (dry_run: false) spawns agent processes, waits for them, and consumes their session budgets. reap_only reaps + GCs without dispatching.

dry_run.description: Default true. Set false to actually launch agents.

agent.description: Only dispatch tasks for this agent tag.

reap_only.description: Only reap stale ledger rows and GC worktrees.

name: doctor
description: Diagnose apple-tasks setup for THIS host process: Reminders/Calendar permission status, dispatcher config, independent Hermes vs Home Assistant healthchecks, Budget Tracker bandwidth, structured issues[], and optional --enqueue-heals (creates [heal][auto] tasks for unhealthy systems; launchd dispatch picks them up — this tool does not spawn agents). TCC grants are per-host-process.

enqueue_heals.description: If true, create one [heal][auto] task per unhealthy system (deduped). Does not dispatch.

list.description: Reminders list for heal tasks (default: Code Tasks). Only used with enqueue_heals.

name: event_create
description: Create a Calendar event. A date-only start (yyyy-MM-dd) makes an all-day event. Tags become a [tag] title prefix.

calendar.description: Calendar name. Omit for the system default calendar.

tags.description: Tags (no spaces/brackets, e.g. 'claude', 'repo2'). Stored as [tag] prefixes on the reminder title.

end.description: Same formats. Mutually exclusive with duration.

duration.description: Duration in minutes (default 60 when end omitted).

start.description: yyyy-MM-dd for all-day events, ISO8601 otherwise.

name: event_delete
description: Delete a Calendar event permanently.

name: event_list
description: List Calendar events in a date range (default: today through +7 days). Filter by calendar and tags (AND). Same [tag] title convention as tasks.

calendar.description: Calendar name. Omit for all calendars.

tags.description: Tags (no spaces/brackets, e.g. 'claude', 'repo2'). Stored as [tag] prefixes on the reminder title.

from.description: Range start: yyyy-MM-dd, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm', or ISO8601. Default: start of today.

to.description: Range end, same formats. Default: from + 7 days.

start.description: yyyy-MM-dd for all-day events, ISO8601 otherwise.

name: event_show
description: Show a single Calendar event by id.

start.description: yyyy-MM-dd for all-day events, ISO8601 otherwise.

name: event_update
description: Update a Calendar event: retitle, add/remove tags, retime, location, notes, or move calendars.

calendar.description: Move the event to this calendar.

start.description: yyyy-MM-dd for all-day events, ISO8601 otherwise.

name: files_scan
description: Read .txt/.md files dropped in the iCloud inbox folder since the last scan (watermark auto-advances; first run looks back 24h). The universal capture escape hatch — any device drops a file, this emits {file, modified, content}. Set archive:true to move processed files into a done/ subfolder.

since.description: Override watermark (yyyy-MM-dd, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm', or ISO8601). Stateless: does not advance the stored watermark.

archive.description: Move processed files into a done/ subfolder.

name: findmy_devices
description: List Find My accessories configured for the FindMy.py sidecar (AirTags/OpenHaystack tags whose pairing files are in ~/.config/apple-tasks/findmy/accessories/). Requires one-time interactive setup: 'python3 tools/findmy/findmy-sidecar.py login'. Returns {error, hint} JSON when unconfigured.

error.description: Present when this accessory's pairing file failed to load.

name: findmy_locate
description: Fetch the latest Find My network location report for a configured accessory by name (see findmy_devices). Uses the owner's own Apple account via the FindMy.py sidecar; read-only.

name.description: Accessory name (file stem or pairing name).

name: github_sync
description: Two-way GitHub issue sync via the gh CLI: assigned open issues become [github]-tagged tasks (issue URL = dedupe key), closed issues complete their reminders, and completed reminders close their issues only when close_issues is true. dry_run defaults TRUE from MCP — pass dry_run: false to apply.

list.description: Reminders list for created tasks (default "Code Tasks").

tags.description: Tags (no spaces/brackets, e.g. 'claude', 'repo2'). Stored as [tag] prefixes on the reminder title.

assignee.description: Issue assignee filter for gh (default @me; "all" disables).

close_issues.description: Close GitHub issues whose reminders are completed (outbound writes; default false).

dry_run.description: Default TRUE from MCP: report without changing anything.

externalId.description: Sync-stable identifier; also accepted wherever a task id is.

nativeTags.description: add/update only: whether tags were mirrored to native Reminders tags.

subtask.description: update only: whether a --parent subtask change was applied.

recurred.description: complete only: completing this recurring task rolled it to the next occurrence (shown still open).

fileURL.description: Path in the Reminders store; reading the file needs Full Disk Access.

attached.description: task_update attach_* only: whether the attach succeeded.

section.description: task_show with section: true only — the task's section name.

sectionApplied.description: task_update section only: whether the assign succeeded.

wouldCloseIssues.description: Completed reminders' open issues; rerun with close_issues to close.

name: gmail_scan
description: List Gmail inbox messages newer than the last scan (watermarked capture feed; first call looks back 24h). Headers + snippet only, newest first; use gmail_show for a body. Read-only scope — no send path exists. Needs a one-time 'apple-tasks gmail login' from a terminal.

query.description: Extra Gmail search terms ANDed with the watermark (e.g. 'from:boss@example.com').

name: gmail_show
description: Show one Gmail message including its plain-text body. Read-only.

name: mail_draft
description: Create a DRAFT in Mail.app — never sends; the human reviews and hits send. Either a new message (to + subject) or a reply (reply_to: an RFC Message-ID from a [mail] task's notes, or a numeric id from mail_scan; threading preserved, subject defaults to Re: <original>).

subject.description: Required for new drafts; optional override for replies.

reply_to.description: Message to reply to (RFC Message-ID or mail_scan numeric id).

inReplyTo.description: Reply mode: id of the message being replied to.

name: mail_scan
description: List Mail.app inbox message headers (id, subject, from, received, read) since a timestamp. Headers only, newest first; use mail_show for a body. Read-only.

name: mail_show
description: Show one Mail.app inbox message including its plain-text body.

name: note_create
description: Create a NEW Apple Note (existing notes are never edited). Body is HTML; the title is prepended as an <h1> and becomes the note's name.

title.description: Note title (first line of the note).

name: notes_scan
description: List Apple Notes modified since the last scan (watermark auto-advances; first run looks back 24h). Returns plain-text bodies. Read-only. Use this to find action items that should become tasks (task_create) or events (event_create); put the source note's name in the created item's notes field for provenance.

since.description: Override watermark (yyyy-MM-dd, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm', or ISO8601). Stateless: does not advance the stored watermark.

folder.description: Present only when the scan was folder-filtered.

body.description: Plain text (HTML stripped), truncated to max_chars.

name: notify
description: Show a local macOS notification banner (e.g. to report a finished task). push: true also sends it via ntfy so it reaches the user's phone off-Mac (requires ~/.config/apple-tasks/notify.json). Respects the config's quietHours window (suppressed but still succeeds); force: true overrides for priority pings.

suppressedQuietHours.description: Window that suppressed this notification, when it did.

name: plan_create
description: Create a new Reminders list to serve as a plan.

name: plan_list
description: List Reminders lists. Each list is a plan; its reminders are the plan's tasks.

name: readinglist_scan
description: Read Safari Reading List items added since the last scan (watermark auto-advances; first run looks back 24h). Emits {title, url, dateAdded, previewText}, oldest first. Requires Full Disk Access for the host process; the doctor command reports FDA status. Read-only.

since.description: Override watermark (yyyy-MM-dd, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm', or ISO8601). Stateless: does not advance the stored watermark.

max_items.description: Limit output to this many items (default 50).

name: run_log
description: Read a dispatch run's captured agent output (~/.config/apple-tasks/runs/<ledger_id>.log). Header lines record provider/model (and Cursor Auto's resolved model). Returns the last `tail` lines (reads at most the final 256 KB).

name: screenshots_scan
description: OCR screenshots/images modified since the last scan (watermark auto-advances; first run looks back 24h). On-device Vision, read-only. Returns {file, modified, text} per image. Use to turn 'screenshot it to deal with later' captures into tasks/events (task_create/event_create); keep the file path as provenance.

since.description: Override watermark (yyyy-MM-dd, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm', or ISO8601). Stateless: does not advance the stored watermark.

text.description: Recognized text; empty when the image has none.

name: shortcut_list
description: List the names of all Shortcuts available on this Mac (via the macOS 'shortcuts' CLI).

name: shortcut_run
description: Run a macOS Shortcut by name, optionally passing text input, and return its text output. Escape hatch to anything Shortcuts can do: HomeKit, Focus modes, notifications, etc.

input.description: Text passed to the shortcut as input.

name: suggest
description: Proactive suggestions: reviews the next week's calendar, upcoming birthdays, stale tasks, and recent agent activity, and PROPOSES tasks/events/drops. Nothing is ever created — apply accepted proposals yourself via task_create/event_create.

stale_weeks.description: Open [read]/claimed/overdue tasks older than this count as stale (default 4).

no_contacts.description: Skip the birthday feed (no Contacts prompt).

agent.description: Model seat: 'local' (on-device Apple model) or an agents.json lane (CLI or BYOM llm). Default: agents.json suggest.agent, else local.

reason.description: Why this is worth raising, citing the signal.

name: task_complete
description: Mark a task completed. Recurring tasks roll to their next occurrence instead (response has recurred=true, completed=false, and the next due date).

externalId.description: Sync-stable identifier; also accepted wherever a task id is.

tags.description: Tags (no spaces/brackets, e.g. 'claude', 'repo2'). Stored as [tag] prefixes on the reminder title.

append_notes.description: Append a paragraph to the notes, keeping the existing body (use for outcome summaries).

list.description: Move the task to this list.

parent.description: Make this task a subtask of the given task id (native Reminders subtask, via the private helper).

clear_recurrence.description: Remove the repeat rule (series stops recurring).

attach_file.description: Attach a file by absolute path (copied into the Reminders store).

attach_url.description: Attach a URL as a rich attachment (distinct from the url field).

clear_parent.description: Detach from the parent task (stays in its list).

name: triage_inbox
description: One-shot triage of untagged inbox reminders: a cheap classifier agent tags each as agent-work or personal and routes agent work to a plan list. dry_run defaults to TRUE (reports proposed changes, mutates nothing); pass dry_run: false to apply. Replaces the /loop triage pattern.

agent.description: Classifier: an agents.json tag, or "local" for the on-device Apple model (macOS 26+).

include_notes.description: Also scan Apple Notes (shared watermark; advanced only when applying) and turn action items into tasks/events with the source note's name for provenance.

dry_run.description: Default true. Set false to apply tags/list moves.

name: watch_list
description: Show configured topic watches and their scan state (last fetch, due now?).

name: watch_scan
description: Fetch each due topic watch (RSS feeds / web pages from ~/.config/apple-tasks/watches.json) and emit items new since the last scan. Per-watch cadence and seen-state; first run records a baseline. Failed watches are reported per-watch, never fatal.

force.description: Fetch every watch now, ignoring cadence.

watch.description: Name of the watch that produced this item.

ts.description: Item timestamp (feed pubDate when parseable, else scan time), ISO8601.

note.description: 'content changed' for url watches; feed summary for rss.

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch a URL and return {url, status, title, text} with HTML reduced to readable text. Minimal web primitive for agents without their own web access; prefer your native web tools if you have them.

name: whereami
description: Get this Mac's current location (CoreLocation): lat/lon, accuracy, and reverse-geocoded place. Use for location context (am I home? what city am I in?). First use needs a Location Services grant for the MCP host process — run doctor if it times out.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a fix (default 15).

place.description: Absent with no_geocode or when reverse geocoding fails.
